audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Teemo levels 2 and 3 and called every later stage 'Skill', on a 55.15% matchup over 1039 games — the largest sample in this slice — while whys[1] through whys[5] all describe Ryze winning those stages. The page also rated the lane 'Tricky — 7/10'.
audit.why: Teemo owns only level 1, before Rune Prison exists. From level 2 a rooted, dashless Teemo eats a full magic-damage rotation that Blinding Dart cannot touch, and that only improves with items. Two-plus items goes back to Skill because of shroom map control, not the duel.
audit.corrected: Row 1 -> Skill, rows 2-5 -> Ryze as matched pairs with ratings; diff -> FAVOURED, tone -> the favoured green, diffRating -> 4/10, carryRating -> 5.5/10, both difficulty lines updated.

audit.why: Level 3 (full loop vs an escape-less target), the first mana item, and Teemo's late shroom network are the breakpoints, and spikes[0..3] carry all of them.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] was incoherent — it said Blinding Dart makes 'your empowered Q slow or root fire into a blind window he can kite through'. Blind affects basic attacks, not spells, which the rest of the page states correctly. Blinding Dart's numbers (flat 7s at every rank, 680 range) appeared nowhere despite the whole page being keyed to its cooldown.
audit.why: A flat 7-second cooldown that never improves is the single most exploitable fact in this lane — you do not have to track five different rank values, you count to seven. And a player who thinks blind touches spells will hold a rotation they could have fired.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[0], dosFull[0].d and report[5].t rewritten with the flat cooldown, the range, and the autos-only rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were absent: Toxic Shot applying on-hit poison that ticks for 4 seconds and scales with his attack speed, and Guerrilla Warfare — Teemo turns invisible standing still, keeps it while moving in brush, and leaves invisibility with bonus attack speed.
audit.why: The on-hit scaling is why armour alone misreads the trade, and the brush invisibility plus Element of Surprise is exactly how a Ryze with no dash dies to a facecheck he thought was safe.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0].d states the on-hit poison; spikes[0].text states the brush invisibility and the attack-speed exit.

notes: The FAVOURED token and '#3ddc97' are both taken from existing entries in this champion's data (ryze vs sion carried diff FAVOURED; ryze vs shen and tahmkench carry the green), so neither is invented. The Teemo-side mirror flagged that Ryze's own kit is badly described across this champion's content — an invented shield, an invented unconditional root, and Overload's reset described backwards (it resets off his OTHER ability casts, not off autos). I did not find those specific errors inside this matchup's writable fields, but the mirror's advice to re-read the whole champion after the applier runs is worth passing on. wants.foe[1] calls Move Quick 'his passive' — it is his W; it did not rewrite inside the band without dropping the spacing point.
